description: This file implements a PPC-specific stack walker for the Google Breakpad crash reporting system, including methods to retrieve context and caller frames, with handling for 32-bit PPC architecture.

classes.name: StackwalkerPPC
classes.description: A PPC-specific implementation of a stack walker for processing call stacks during crash analysis.

methods.name: GetContextFrame
methods.description: Retrieves the current context frame based on the CPU context.

methods.name: GetCallerFrame
methods.description: Retrieves the caller's stack frame based on the current stack and context.
